mode: readonly + query_only; consistent SQLite read transaction

proposals.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n FROM self_improvements GROUP BY status

panels.sql: SELECT status,json_extract(consensus_json,'$.decision') decision,COUNT(*) n FROM specialist_panels GROUP BY 1,2

linked_panel_states.sql: SELECT json_extract(p.consensus_json,'$.decision') decision,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM specialist_reviews v WHERE v.panel_id=p.id) THEN 'reviewed' ELSE 'unreviewed' END reviewed,COUNT(*) n FROM specialist_panels p WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM self_improvements s WHERE s.panel_id=p.id) GROUP BY 1,2

refined_goals.sql: SELECT g.status,COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) children FROM self_improvements s JOIN goals g ON g.improvement_id=s.id WHERE s.refined_from_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1

yield_7d.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n FROM self_improvements WHERE julianday(updated_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1

panels_24h.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM specialist_panels WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?)

reviews_24h.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT panel_id) panels FROM specialist_reviews WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?)

work_items.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n FROM work_items WHERE status IN ('candidate','triaged','planned','leased','blocked') GROUP BY 1

skill_outcome_provenance.sql: SELECT domain,COUNT(*) n,SUM(success) success,SUM(task_id IS NOT NULL) task_link,SUM(agent_id IS NOT NULL) agent_link,SUM(skill_version IS NOT NULL) version_link,SUM(skill_content_hash IS NOT NULL) hash_link,SUM(model IS NOT NULL) model_link,SUM(json_array_length(evidence_refs_json)>0) evidence_link,SUM(tokens_used>0) measured_tokens,SUM(tokens_used) recorded_tokens,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM skill_outcomes GROUP BY 1

skills.sql: SELECT skill_id,COUNT(*) n,SUM(success) successes,SUM(tokens_used) tokens,SUM(tokens_used=0 OR tokens_used IS NULL) missing_tokens,ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)) mean_ms,MIN(created_at) first_at,MAX(created_at) last_at,COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) agents,COUNT(DISTINCT skill_content_hash) hashes,COUNT(DISTINCT model) models FROM skill_outcomes GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

skill_cards.sql: SELECT kind,lane,status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(updated_at) last_at FROM skill_cards GROUP BY 1,2,3

agents.sql: SELECT a.id,a.name,a.agent_type,a.status,a.model,a.total_tasks recorded_total,a.completed_tasks recorded_completed,a.failed_tasks recorded_failed,a.retired_at,a.capabilities,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id) linked_tasks,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks t WHERE t.agent_id=a.id AND t.status='completed') completed_tasks,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_skills s WHERE s.agent_id=a.id AND s.enabled=1) enabled_skills FROM agents a ORDER BY a.id

capabilities.sql: SELECT c.id,c.kind,c.owner,c.version,c.status,c.risk_ceiling,c.input_schema_ref,c.output_schema_ref,c.allowed_actions_json,c.forbidden_actions_json,c.required_evidence_json,c.eval_score,c.eval_threshold,c.removal_strategy,c.updated_at,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases l WHERE l.capability_id=c.id) leases,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases l WHERE l.capability_id=c.id AND l.status='completed') completed_leases,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases l WHERE l.capability_id=c.id AND julianday(l.created_at)>=julianday(?)) leases_7d FROM swarm_capabilities c ORDER BY c.id

lease_outcomes_7d.sql: SELECT role,runtime,status,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG((julianday(updated_at)-julianday(created_at))*86400000)) mean_elapsed_ms FROM worker_leases WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2,3

lease_capability_coverage.sql: SELECT role,COUNT(*) n,SUM(capability_id IS NOT NULL) with_capability,SUM(parent_lease_id IS NOT NULL) with_parent,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM worker_leases GROUP BY 1

subagent_spawns.sql: SELECT status,reject_reason,depth,runtime,COUNT(*) n,SUM(token_budget_grant) granted_tokens,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM sub_agent_spawns GROUP BY 1,2,3,4

coordination_cohorts.sql: WITH per_run AS (SELECT r.id,r.loop_name,r.status,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases l WHERE l.loop_run_id=r.id AND l.role='maker') makers,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_leases l WHERE l.loop_run_id=r.id AND l.role IN ('checker','security_checker')) reviews,(julianday(r.updated_at)-julianday(r.created_at))*86400 seconds FROM loop_runs r WHERE julianday(r.created_at)>=julianday(?)) SELECT loop_name,CASE WHEN makers=0 THEN 'no_maker' WHEN makers=1 THEN 'single_maker' ELSE 'multi_maker' END cohort,status,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(reviews),2) mean_review_leases,ROUND(AVG(seconds)) mean_elapsed_s FROM per_run GROUP BY 1,2,3

memory_candidates.sql: SELECT memory_type,status,promotion_status,human_required,sensitivity,store,COUNT(*) n,MAX(updated_at) last_at FROM memory_candidates GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6

memory_access.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) accesses,COUNT(DISTINCT candidate_id) candidates,COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) callers,MIN(accessed_at) first_at,MAX(accessed_at) last_at FROM memory_access_log

memory_types.sql: SELECT type,source,COUNT(*) n,ROUND(AVG(confidence),3) mean_claimed_confidence FROM central_memories GROUP BY 1,2

memory_hash_duplicates.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) groups,SUM(n-1) duplicate_rows FROM (SELECT content_hash,COUNT(*) n FROM memory_candidates WHERE content_hash IS NOT NULL GROUP BY content_hash HAVING n>1)

outcome_learning.sql: SELECT status,signal_status,causal_support,COUNT(*) n,MAX(replications) max_replications,MAX(updated_at) last_at FROM outcome_learning_assessments GROUP BY 1,2,3

evidence_edges.sql: SELECT relation,COUNT(*) n FROM swarm_evidence_edges GROUP BY 1

outbox.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,MAX(attempts) max_attempts,MIN(created_at) oldest,MAX(published_at) last_published FROM event_outbox GROUP BY 1

external_events.sql: SELECT source,event_type,COUNT(*) n,MAX(occurred_at) last_occurred,MAX(ingested_at) last_ingested FROM external_events GROUP BY 1,2

model_calls_7d.sql: SELECT consumer,provider,model,COUNT(*) n,SUM(ok) ok,ROUND(AVG(latency_ms)) mean_latency_ms,SUM(tokens_in) tokens_in,SUM(tokens_out) tokens_out,SUM(run_id IS NOT NULL) run_links,SUM(experiment_id IS NOT NULL) experiment_links,SUM(cost_basis IS NOT NULL) price_basis,SUM(list_price_cost) list_price,SUM(marginal_cost) marginal_cost,MAX(created_at) last_at,MAX(CASE WHEN ok=0 THEN created_at END) last_failure FROM llm_model_calls WHERE julianday(created_at)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY n DESC
